+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DocumentRequest:
+    document_bytes: bytes
+    mime_type: str
+    metadata: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DocumentField:
+    name: str
+    value: Optional[str]
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+
+
+def build_request(payload, default_mime_type: str = "application/pdf"):
+    return DocumentRequest(
+        document_bytes=payload.get("document_bytes", b""),
+        mime_type=payload.get("mime_type", default_mime_type),
+        metadata={k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k not in {"document_bytes", "mime_type"}},
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_fields(fields: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {k: (v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v) for k, v in fields.items()}
+
+
+def pack_items(items: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [normalize_fields(item) for item in items]

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+from document_models import pack_items
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"}
+    )
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(
+        request={
+            "name": name,
+            "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+                content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"]
+            ),
+        }
+    )
+    fields, items = {}, []
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ == "item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            items.append({"description": values.get("description"), "amount": values.get("amount")})
+        else:
+            fields[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+    return {"receipts": [{"merchant": fields.get("merchant_name"), "tax": fields.get("tax_amount"), "total": fields.get("total_amount"), "items": pack_items(items)}]}
*** End Patch
